name: SK_Goon_Hoodie
description: Goon, outfit 0 of 3: a masked gunman of the Vultures crew in a black hoodie. Skeletal mesh on the shared Goon skeleton (UE5 mannequin compatible), facing -Y in Blender, origin on the ground between the feet, A-pose. Body, shared by all three outfits: a lean adult man about 1.75 m tall in sneakers (1.78 m over the hood). Heights above the ground: neck base 1.50 m, shoulder joints 1.42 m (0.40 m apart, 0.53 m over the sleeves), waist 1.05 m, hip joints 0.93 m (0.19 m apart), elbows 1.14 m, wrists 0.87 m, knees 0.50 m, ankles 0.085 m. Upper arm 0.28 m, forearm 0.27 m, thigh 0.43 m, shin 0.415 m. Head under the mask 0.20 m wide, 0.24 m tall, 0.22 m deep. Chest 0.42 m wide, 0.25 m deep. Outfit: black cotton pullover hoodie with the hood UP and gathered on the shoulders, a front pouch pocket, two oxblood drawstrings (about 0.12 m), a dark oxblood ribbed waistband and cuffs; dark indigo-grey denim jeans; a pale bone-coloured full-face knitted ski mask showing inside the hood, with two narrow slanted eye slits (0.046 x 0.017 m, black inside) and a vertical mouth seam. Shared kit: black gloves; pale off-white low sneakers (0.29 m long, 0.10 m wide) with a lighter sole and an oxblood heel tab; the crew mark on the back of the hoodie, an oxblood V of two bars 0.20 m long and 0.03 m wide, each leaning 24 degrees outward, centred 1.29 m above the ground. No skin shows anywhere. Also model the sling that holds the pipe (SM_Weapon_GoonPipe) diagonally across his back, grip at the right shoulder blade, striking end at the left hip; the SMG (SM_Weapon_GoonSMG) is a separate mesh held in both hands. Must deform cleanly through a run, a kneel on the right knee, a shouldered aim, an overhead swing of the right arm and a collapse onto back or front. Must read at a glance in full sun: a black figure, oxblood accents, a pale face. The count is the pool cap for all Goons, shared by the three outfits (the outfit is random per spawn).
colours: #7c151d drawstrings, crew mark on the back, sneaker heel tab
gameplay: Enemy on foot, 90 / 110 / 130 hit points. Hit volumes are not the mesh: a head sphere of radius 0.155 m (x2.2 damage) and a body capsule of radius 0.27 m that follow the pose. Movement capsule radius 0.3 m, height 1.8 m. A dead Goon stays as a body (up to 6) that gives no cover and blocks nothing.

name: SK_Goon_Puffer
description: Goon, outfit 1 of 3: the same man and skeleton as SK_Goon_Hoodie (about 1.75 m tall in sneakers; shoulder joints 1.42 m high and 0.40 m apart; hip joints 0.93 m; knees 0.50 m; upper arm 0.28 m, forearm 0.27 m, thigh 0.43 m, shin 0.415 m), facing -Y in Blender, origin on the ground between the feet, A-pose. Outfit: a charcoal quilted puffer jacket, hip length, with four horizontal quilted bands on the torso (0.40 m wide at the waist growing to 0.47 m at the chest, up to 0.30 m deep), black stitched seams between the bands, an oxblood shoulder yoke and oxblood shoulder caps, a tall stand-up collar reaching the jaw, an oxblood front zip (0.38 m), sleeves about 16 % thicker than the hoodie's with one seam ring on the upper arm and one on the forearm, a dark oxblood hem line; charcoal trousers. Head: a black knitted beanie with a turned-up oxblood cuff, dark wrap-around glasses (0.19 m wide), a pale bone-coloured bandana tied over the nose and mouth and hanging to a point on the chest, and the same pale mask fabric covering whatever the three leave open: no skin shows. Shared kit as on the hoodie outfit: black gloves, pale off-white sneakers with an oxblood heel tab, the oxblood V crew mark on the back of the jacket (two bars 0.20 x 0.03 m leaning 24 degrees outward, centred 1.29 m up), the pipe sling across the back. Same deformation and readability requirements as SK_Goon_Hoodie. The count is the pool cap for all Goons, shared by the three outfits.
colours: #7c151d shoulder yoke, shoulder caps, zip, beanie cuff, crew mark, heel tab
gameplay: Enemy on foot, identical to the other outfits: 90 / 110 / 130 hit points, head sphere radius 0.155 m (x2.2), body capsule radius 0.27 m, movement capsule 0.3 m x 1.8 m. The bulk of the jacket changes nothing.

name: SK_Goon_Tracksuit
description: Goon, outfit 2 of 3: the same man and skeleton as SK_Goon_Hoodie (about 1.75 m tall in sneakers; shoulder joints 1.42 m high and 0.40 m apart; hip joints 0.93 m; knees 0.50 m; upper arm 0.28 m, forearm 0.27 m, thigh 0.43 m, shin 0.415 m), facing -Y in Blender, origin on the ground between the feet, A-pose. Outfit: a black polyester track jacket zipped to the top with a short stand-up collar and an oxblood zip (0.40 m), and black track trousers; one oxblood stripe about 3 cm wide runs down the outside of each sleeve from shoulder to cuff and down the outside of each leg from hip to ankle. Head: a black fitted baseball cap worn BACKWARDS, its oxblood brim (0.15 m wide, 0.09 m long) pointing to the rear and tilted slightly up, over a pale bone-coloured full-face knitted ski mask with two narrow slanted eye slits and a mouth seam; the mask is tucked into the collar so no neck shows. Shared kit as on the hoodie outfit: black gloves, pale off-white sneakers with an oxblood heel tab, the oxblood V crew mark on the back of the jacket (two bars 0.20 x 0.03 m leaning 24 degrees outward, centred 1.29 m up), the pipe sling across the back. Same deformation and readability requirements as SK_Goon_Hoodie. The count is the pool cap for all Goons, shared by the three outfits.
colours: #7c151d sleeve and leg stripes, zip, cap brim, crew mark, heel tab
#b5ad9c mask seam and the part tucked into the collar
gameplay: Enemy on foot, identical to the other outfits: 90 / 110 / 130 hit points, head sphere radius 0.155 m (x2.2), body capsule radius 0.27 m, movement capsule 0.3 m x 1.8 m.

name: SM_Weapon_GoonSMG
description: The Goon's gun: a generic compact pistol-calibre submachine gun with a fixed stock. Barrel toward +X, up +Z, origin where the right hand holds the pistol grip (not a ground pivot: it lives in the hands). Overall 0.64 m long (0.39 m ahead of the origin, 0.25 m behind), 0.27 m tall with the magazine, 0.046 m wide. Parts: a box receiver 0.27 m long, 0.072 m tall, 0.046 m wide, from 0.08 m behind the origin to 0.19 m ahead, underside level with the origin; a short handguard 0.15 m long, 0.046 m tall, 0.036 m wide, from 0.19 to 0.34 m ahead; the barrel end with a muzzle device 0.024 m across and 0.06 m long, from 0.33 to 0.39 m ahead, bore axis 0.042 m above the origin; a pistol grip 0.10 m long below the origin; a straight stick magazine 0.17 m long (0.042 x 0.03 m section) in a well 0.085 m ahead of the grip, hanging to 0.18 m below the origin; a fixed stock strut 0.19 m long with a butt plate 0.085 m tall, ending 0.25 m behind the origin; a short sight rail 0.07 m long on top (0.09 m above the origin); a weapon light under the handguard, 0.036 m across and 0.075 m long, its lens (0.032 m) 0.32 m ahead of the origin. Sockets in this space, cm: Muzzle (38.5, 0, 4.2), Light (31.8, 0, -0.2), SupportHand (17, 0, -1.2), Butt (-23.5, 0, 3). Worn dark steel and polymer, scratches on the edges, tape on the stock is welcome. No maker's marks and not a copy of any specific make. The light's lens must be its own emissive material: it flares warm white for half a second before every burst, which is the player's warning. After a kill the gun lies on its side on the street beside the body. Keep the magazine as a separate part.
colours: #24262c receiver, grip, stock, butt plate, muzzle, light housing
gameplay: The Goon's ranged attack: bursts of 4 / 5 / 6 rounds, one every 0.11 s, 4 / 6 / 8 damage each, always announced by the weapon light for 0.5 s. Not a pickup. Dropped beside the body on death, without collision.

name: SM_Weapon_GoonPipe
description: The Goon's melee weapon: a length of 1 inch galvanised steel water pipe. Long axis along X, striking end toward +X, origin at the centre of the fist that holds it: the grip end is 0.14 m behind the origin, the striking end 0.57 m ahead. Pipe 0.70 m long and 0.034 m across; a threaded coupling 0.05 m across and 0.05 m long screwed onto the striking end (from 0.52 to 0.57 m ahead of the origin); 0.15 m of black cloth or electrical tape wound around the other end as a grip (from 0.115 m behind the origin to 0.035 m ahead), slightly thicker than the pipe (0.04 m). Dull zinc with spangle, thread marks at both ends, scuffs and a few dents, rust at the cut edges. It rides diagonally across the Goon's back, grip at the right shoulder blade (0.15 m right of and 0.15 m behind the middle of the shoulder line), striking end toward the left hip, and is drawn over the right shoulder; the sling that holds it there is modelled with the outfits.
gameplay: The rush: inside 3 m a Goon winds up for 0.28 s, dashes at 9.5 m/s and lands one blow for 15 / 22 / 30 damage inside 1.35 m. Stays strapped to the body on death. Not a pickup.

name: SK_Buzzard
description: The Buzzard: the Vultures' armed quadcopter, a heavy-lift drone that the crew has fitted with a gun. Skeletal mesh with six bones (body, four props, one gimbal). ORIENTATION: nose toward +X like a vehicle, NOT the -Y of characters; up +Z; origin at the centre of the airframe (it has no ground pivot: it never lands). Overall 1.02 m long, 1.07 m across the prop discs, 0.35 m tall; motors 0.89 m apart on the diagonal. Positions below are metres from the origin as (forward, right, up); in Blender forward is +X, up is +Z and the drone's right is -Y, so the 'right' values change sign on the Blender Y axis (the gun hangs on the -Y side, the red port light sits at +Y). Hull: a flat faceted lozenge 0.56 m long, 0.30 m wide, 0.11 m deep, centred 0.02 m aft, with a raised top deck (0.50 x 0.26 m tapering upward, 0.06 m tall) and an oxblood spine panel (0.34 x 0.07 m) on top at +0.13 m. Nose: a hooked beak, a four-sided pointed fairing 0.24 m long and 0.20 m wide at its base that droops 11 degrees, tip 0.48 m ahead, with an oxblood brow plate (0.12 x 0.10 m, tilted 17 degrees) above it. Tail: a boom 0.26 m long (0.05 x 0.04 m) reaching 0.53 m aft, carrying a V tail of two oxblood fins 0.15 m tall with 0.11 m chord, canted 34 degrees outward, at 0.47 m aft. Four swept arms of 0.045 x 0.03 m section run from the hull to the motor hubs at (0.27, -0.33, 0.075) and (0.27, 0.33, 0.075) in front and (-0.30, -0.35, 0.075) and (-0.30, 0.35, 0.075) behind; under each hub a motor pod 0.09 m across and 0.085 m tall. On each hub a two-blade prop 0.37 m tip to tip (about 15 inches), chord 0.034 m; diagonal pairs turn the same way; each prop is its own bone so it can spin and one can be hidden when the drone is killed. Landing gear: two skid rails 0.40 m long, 0.26 m apart, 0.16 m below the origin, on four splayed struts. Under the nose a two-axis gimbal: pivot at (0.17, 0, -0.085), a ball housing 0.124 m across on a short neck; in it the EYE, a lens 0.072 m across in a 0.09 m ring at (0.255, 0, -0.10) looking forward; on the gimbal's right side the slung gun, a body 0.20 x 0.034 x 0.03 m with a barrel 0.02 m across, muzzle at (0.37, 0.062, -0.13), fed from a small ammunition box (0.07 x 0.05 x 0.045 m) below it. Eye, gun and box are one rigid group on the gimbal bone (yaw 86 degrees either way, pitch 77 degrees down to 29 degrees up). Navigation lights: red at (0.33, -0.36, 0.02) to port, green at (0.33, 0.36, 0.02) to starboard, white at (-0.47, 0, 0.09) on the tail. Sockets: Eye, GunMuzzle, the three lights, the four hubs. Finish: satin black composite and carbon fibre with oxblood panels, anodised motors, exposed wiring at the gun mount, dust and scuffs. The gun is a fiction: small and generic, no real make. The eye is an emissive red lens that must read from its orbit distance (13 to 23 m) in full sun; its brightness is driven by the game (dim on patrol, hard red when it has seen the player, flaring before it fires).
colours: #1c1e24 hull, beak, tail boom, motor pods
#2b2e36 top deck, arms, lens ring, ammunition box
#7c151d spine panel, brow, V tail fins
gameplay: Flying enemy, 45 / 55 / 60 hit points. Hit volume: one ellipsoid 1.0 m across and 0.44 m tall, no weak point. Orbits the player 13 to 23 m out and 4.8 to 7.2 m up; fires three slow tracer bolts after a 0.55 / 0.46 / 0.38 s eye flare. Killed: loses one prop, spins down and bursts where it lands (radius 3 m, 30 damage, 15 at most to the player).

name: SM_Fx_BuzzardRotorBlur
description: The blur of a spinning Buzzard prop: a flat disc 0.37 m across (radius 0.185 m), origin at its centre, facing +Z, unwrapped radially for a blurred-prop texture that is faint in the middle, brightest in a band at 86 % of the radius where the blade tips smear, and soft at the edge. One disc sits 0.022 m above each of the four hubs of SK_Buzzard and takes over from the solid two-blade prop at speed; its opacity follows rotor power (0.25 when dying, 0.75 to 1 in flight). Two-sided, translucent, casts no shadow.

name: SM_Fx_BuzzardBolt
description: The Buzzard's projectile as the player sees it: a red tracer bolt. A stretched teardrop along X with its head at +X and the origin at the head, 2.4 m long and 0.11 m across, plus a round hot head about 0.34 m across (a separate shell or sprite at the origin). For a mesh or ribbon renderer in the effects system; emissive only, no shading, no shadow. The tail grows from nothing to its full 2.4 m over the first 2.4 m of flight. It must stay red against a sunlit wall: by day the core should cover what is behind it, not only add to it.
materials: emissive tracer (unlit, additive at night, partly opaque core by day)
colours: #ff3a22 pushed toward orange-white for the head (about 9 x overbright)
gameplay: Dodgeable projectile: 70 m/s, straight, no gravity, gone after 1.3 s (91 m); 7 / 10 / 13 damage when it passes within 0.36 m of the player's body; stops on any world surface.

name: SM_Fx_BuzzardWreck
description: Optional debris set: SK_Buzzard broken up by its crash, as separate pieces with their own pivots (or one pre-fractured collection): four arm stubs with their motor pods, one clean prop 0.37 m long (the prop that flies off the moment the drone is killed) and two bent ones, two hull halves showing the oxblood spine, the V tail, the gimbal ball with a dead lens, the gun, the skids. Snapped carbon fibre, torn wiring, scorch marks. The web game shows none of this: it throws four dark chips when the prop comes off and then draws a small explosion with electric sparks in place of the airframe, so this set is an upgrade, not a requirement. Pieces should be small (the largest about 0.5 m) and short-lived.
gameplay: none (cosmetic; must not block movement or shots)
